title: 6 integration test files still INSERT/SELECT against the stale table name 'dead_letter_queue', renamed to 'dead_letter_items' by migration 072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql
summary: Discovered while implementing and verifying the ISS-0095 fix (GitHub #349). tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig, obs06_alerts_test.zig, ext01_service_task_test.zig, ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig, iss207_error_retry_test.zig, and sch02_timer_polling_test.zig all issue queries against a table literally named 'dead_letter_queue' in their test bodies (INSERT/SELECT statements, not just cleanup helpers). migrations/072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql renamed this table to 'dead_letter_items' as part of the TNT-01 schema-per-tenant cutover; the old name does not exist in any schema (confirmed via direct psql query against bpm_test). Every test case in these 6 files that touches the DLQ table fails with 'relation "dead_letter_queue" does not exist', independent of and unrelated to ISS-0095's tenant-context routing fix -- ISS-0095's fix correctly routes these queries to the right tenant schema, but the table name itself inside the schema is wrong.

root_cause.details: This is a sibling defect to the already-CLOSED ISS-0088/GitHub #337, which fixed the same rename-desync problem but only in tools/clean_test_db.py's TABLES list and tests/integration/helpers.zig's resetTestData() cleanup helper -- best-effort cleanup code, not test assertion bodies. The 6 files named here have their own direct SQL literals referencing 'dead_letter_queue' inside actual test-case logic (INSERT/SELECT used as test setup or assertions), which ISS-0088's fix did not touch and does not cover.

files_to_change: tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig -- replace 'dead_letter_queue' with 'dead_letter_items' in all SQL literals
tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig -- same (also has an unrelated column-drift issue on webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref, noted separately if it persists after this fix)
resolution: Already resolved. Confirmed on current main: `grep -rn dead_letter_queue tests/integration/` returns zero matches in any of the 6 originally-named files (obs05_dlq_test.zig, obs06_alerts_test.zig, ext01_service_task_test.zig, ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig, iss207_error_retry_test.zig, sch02_timer_polling_test.zig) -- all six were already fixed by earlier, separately-tracked work in this session or before (obs05_dlq_test.zig specifically was touched by WF03-GH379-20260809's DLQ fix). The only remaining source-tree occurrence of the literal string 'dead_letter_queue' is in tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig, which is a deliberate meta-regression test (TC-ISS-0123-01) whose entire purpose is to search src/ and tests/integration/ for exactly this stale literal and fail if found anywhere -- it is the search target string, not a live bug. Ran `zig build test-integration-iss0123` directly: 2/2 pass, confirming zero other files carry the stale reference. No code change made; issue closed as already-resolved.

occurrences.context: Found during BACKEND-DEV's implementation and ORCH's independent TEST-RUNNER verification of the ISS-0095 fix (GitHub #349), while triaging full zig build test-integration failures remaining in the 20 files touched by that fix. BACKEND-DEV confirmed via git stash that this failure is pre-existing (present identically before and after the ISS-0095 fix), not a regression.

prevention: A CI check or zig build step that verifies string-literal table names in test files exist in the live schema would catch this class of defect at build time rather than at test-run time -- same prevention note as ISS-0088.
